Thank you for taking the time to look at Plumemu.

**I do not take code pull requests, and this one will be closed without being read.** That is not a
comment on your work. Plumemu is a one-person project, and I keep the right to decide its code and
its licence myself, so a fix is always written again here from its description and never pasted.

What helps instead:

- **An issue.** Describe what is wrong or what you would like, with your device and Plumemu version
  (Settings › About). If you already have a fix in mind, describe it in the issue; I will read it
  and credit you in the changelog.
- **A translation.** A pull request that only changes a file under `translations/` is welcome.

Please close this pull request and open an issue. Thank you.
